d.ko: A two-hour animated film. Follow Zodiac 1, an ace pilot out for revenge against the Empire, across 12 episodes of 3D dogfights and hand-drawn 2D animation, with a full voice cast and an original orchestral score. Nearly five years of work by a handful of independent artists.

d.zh: 一部两小时的动画电影。王牌飞行员黄道一号誓要向帝国复仇：全片共12集，3D空战与手绘2D交织，全程配音，原创管弦乐配乐。由寥寥数位独立艺术家历时近五年打造。
